issues.description: The solution SQL for Aufgabe 08 uses two different table identifiers for the Radweg–Gemeinde relationship within the same query. In solution_repository/aufgabe08.sql the FROM clause references Wanderweg_zu_Gemeinde (line 2) while the WHERE clause references Radweg_zu_Gemeinde (line 3). The problem statement (problem_statement.md, lines 50-52) clearly asks for counting Radwege. This inconsistent naming will produce an invalid query (unknown table reference) or a runtime error and will prevent students from obtaining the intended result or understanding the correct join relationship.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the table name consistent with the task (Radweg). Update solution_repository/aufgabe08.sql so both clauses reference Radweg_zu_Gemeinde. For example: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Gemeinde, Radweg_zu_Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel AND Gemeinde.plz > 96400. Alternatively, if the intent was to count Wanderwege, update the problem statement and the WHERE clause to consistently use Wanderweg_zu_Gemeinde.
